docs: point docs links at docs.braintrust.dev (#460)

## Summary

Points links at the old docs domain (`www.braintrust.dev/docs`,
`braintrust.dev/docs`, `braintrustdata.com/docs`) to
`docs.braintrust.dev`. The old links still redirect since the docs
cutover, so this is cleanup. Where a page has moved, the link goes to
its current path instead of through a redirect chain.

- Switches the `bt docs fetch` defaults (`--llms-url`, the
`llms-full.txt` fallback and the SQL reference URL) to
`docs.braintrust.dev`. Support for `docs.braintrust.dev` URLs landed in
#455.
- Updates the docs links that `bt` prints in the help text, setup output
and observability preview notice, plus the README and the `skills/`
files.

The old-domain URLs in the `docs.rs` tests stay, since they check that
old links are still handled.

## Testing

- Every new URL returns 200 from `docs.braintrust.dev` with no redirect.
SDK reference links use the `/versions/latest` alias on purpose.
- `cargo test --bin bt setup::` (112 passed) and `cargo test --bin bt
observability` (24 passed).
- `bt docs fetch --workflow evaluate --strict` with the new default
downloads the same 28 files as `main`. The only difference is the
`source:` URL for the SQL reference in `reference/_index.md`.
- `bt --help` and `bt docs fetch --help` show the new URLs.
